suggestions: I'm grateful for the moment CI finally turns green after three failed runs the night before.
I'm thankful for a cup of kopi O kosong that hits different when the office aircon is set way too cold.
I'm grateful for my mother calling just to ask if I've eaten, even when I'm buried in a sprint.
I'm thankful for the ten quiet minutes after Isyak when the flat finally settles and I can just sit still.
I'm grateful for a senior engineer who reviewed my PR and actually explained the why instead of just clicking approve.
I'm thankful for the one LRT seat I somehow got during peak hour, saving my legs after a day of back-to-back meetings.
I'm grateful for nasi lemak bungkus from the mak cik downstairs who always throws in extra sambal without me asking.
I'm thankful for a paycheck that clears on time, letting me send some back home without doing the math twice.
I'm grateful for a bug that turned out to be a missing semicolon instead of the migration disaster I was dreading.
I'm thankful for the breeze right before a thunderstorm that finally cuts through the humidity on the walk to the station.
I'm grateful for my little cousin's voice notes that make zero sense but somehow fix my whole mood.
I'm thankful for a manager who said take the day off without making me justify it first.
I'm grateful for the azan drifting in from the surau nearby, a nudge to actually get up instead of scrolling for five more minutes.
I'm thankful for finding a mamak still open when I'm heading home from a release that ran past midnight.
I'm grateful for old university friends who still reply in the group chat years later, keeping me grounded outside of work.
